description: This file contains utility functions for handling Matrix message content, including building message content, resolving mentions, handling message relations, and determining media types and voice compatibility within a Matrix client implementation.

methods.name: buildTextContent
methods.description: Constructs a Matrix text message content object, optionally including a relation.

methods.name: enrichMatrixFormattedContent
methods.description: Enhances a Matrix formatted content object with HTML and mentions based on provided markdown.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMentionsForBody
methods.description: Resolves mentions in a message body markdown for Matrix.

methods.name: extractMatrixMentions
methods.description: Extracts mentions information from Matrix message content.

methods.name: diffMatrixMentions
methods.description: Computes the difference in mentions between current and previous mentions.

methods.name: buildReplyRelation
methods.description: Creates a reply relation object for a given message ID.

methods.name: buildThreadRelation
methods.description: Creates a thread relation object with thread ID and optional reply ID.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMsgType
methods.description: Determines the Matrix message type based on MIME type or filename.

methods.name: resolveMatrixVoiceDecision
methods.description: Decides whether to use voice based on user preference and media compatibility.
